tasks.title: Conversation #118
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Are you still going to the concert on Friday afternoon?
Man: I wish I could, but I'll be sitting in the dentist's chair. I made the appointment ages ago.
Woman: That's a shame. I heard. It's going to be an amazing show.
Man: I know. I've been looking forward to it for months.
Woman: Maybe you can catch them next time they're in town. There's always another concert.
Man: True. I'll keep an eye out for their next tour.

questions.stem: Why can't the man attend the concert?

options.B: He has to travel for work.
options.D: He will be sitting at his desk.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士为什么不能去听音乐会？ 定位原文：Man: I wish I could, but I'll be sitting in the dentist's chair. I made the appointment ages ago. 选项分析： A. He forgot to buy tickets. 他忘记买票了。对话中未提及买票问题，所以A选项错误。 B. He has to travel for work. 他得因公出差。对话中未提及工作出差，所以B选项错误。 C. He has a dentist's appointment. 他约了看牙医。男士明确说“sitting in the dentist's chair”（坐在牙医的椅子上），所以C选项正确。 D. He will be sitting at his desk. 他会坐在自己的办公桌前。男士说的是牙医的椅子，不是自己的办公桌，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士建议男士做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Maybe you can catch them next time they're in town. There's always another concert. 选项分析： A. Attend a future concert 去听未来的音乐会。女士建议等乐队下次再来城里时去看，所以A选项正确。 B. Reschedule his appointment 重新预约他的牙医 appointment。女士没有建议改牙医预约，而是建议等下次音乐会，所以B选项错误。 C. Watch the concert online 在网上看音乐会。对话中未提及网络直播，所以C选项错误。 D. Ask for a refund 要求退款。对话中未提及买票或退款，所以D选项错误。
